basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old graphic designer hailing from Seattle. I've been into retro video games and indie music since my college days. I work from home, which gives me the flexibility to browse Reddit sporadically throughout the day. In my free time, I enjoy hiking in the nearby mountains and experimenting with new recipes. I'm currently single and share my apartment with my two rescue dogs. I tend to do most of my Reddit browsing in the evenings, usually between 8 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor of Fine Arts with a concentration in Graphic Design from the University of Washington. My passion for design is matched by my love for music, especially bands like Fleetwood Mac. My interest in technology and gaming is more self-taught, often through online forums and communities.
